title: /auth/me timeout and fallback analysis

timeout_wrapper.deadline_scope: apiRequest call lifetime, including cache/concurrency queue wait and retry attempts
timeout_wrapper.timeout_result: ApiTimeoutError rejection handled by auth fallback

lightweight_session_check.reason: /auth/session is not currently exposed by the frontend proxy allowlist; backend/proxy contracts were intentionally not changed.
lightweight_session_check.normalization: sessionCheckRequest() returns permissions: null even if an unexpected permissions field is present.

fallback_behavior.auth_provider: 401, timeout, and route-change aborts clear session state instead of leaving status=checking.
fallback_behavior.public_only: After 5000ms of checking, renders the public login children.
fallback_behavior.auth_guard: After 5000ms of checking, renders LoginScreen and replaces route with /login.

risk_notes: A live login latency measurement was not run in this workspace because no backend session credentials were provided.
The frontend avoids changing RBAC behavior; permissions remain outside the login critical path.
